limitations: Six exact published PDF revisions and representative pages are a compatibility sample, not a population guarantee.
Read/render, byte-copy export/save, FreeText structural rewrite, strict cleanup and a concrete tiny-region redaction have distinct outcomes.
Existing CFF/CID resources retained by an annotation rewrite do not prove CFF font creation, shaping or new text authoring.
Pixel equivalence is between independently rendered source/output on this Poppler installation; cross-engine reading parity needs manual review.
Actual refusal exception/reason is recorded separately from other document features; feature co-presence alone is not causal evidence.
No Linux/Kylin, physical input/IME, general partial deletion, arbitrary PDF preservation or official performance-parity claim.

visualReview.reviewer: Codex independent verification agent real_corpus_independent; visual interpretation of actual tool-displayed pixels, not a human reviewer claim.
visualReview.method: All 30 current Poppler PNGs were individually loaded through view_image(detail=original) and inspected as full 566-619 by 800 pixel pages in six batches of five. Corresponding source/derived pages were compared visually; hashes below bind exactly those viewed images.

images.findings: Centered GNU Make title is sharp on a white cover, with broad empty margins and no visible missing-glyph boxes.
Original centered cover title stays in position; the added Chinese/ABC/123 line appears at the lower left on white background without clipping.
Chapter 8 header, page number 103, bold section 8.10 and mixed roman/italic/monospace paragraphs remain separated and readable.
The chapter header, bold section title and every visible paragraph line match the source sample; no annotation was added to this middle page.
The full first page is uniformly white; the original central title is gone, consistent with the independently verified empty content stream.
The original header, section title, line wrapping and whitespace of middle page 115 remain intact after deleting page 1 content.
Two-column function/variable index has clear letter headings, dotted leaders and aligned page references with the original page-217 header.
Both index columns, dotted leaders, letter headings and references match source page 229; deletion of first-page objects did not visibly disturb this last page.
Strict cleanup preserves the single centered cover title and all cover whitespace; visible page painting matches the original.
Strict cleanup preserves header, number 103, section heading, italic words and paragraph placement; no visible shift or missing text appears.
2026 W-4 heading, empty personal-information fields, checkboxes, step labels, shaded amount column and signature/employer rows render consistently.

Original W-4 rows, checkboxes and amount cells retain their positions. The test CJK line is present but its fixed bottom-left rectangle visibly overprints part of the Employer area and a border; this is a placement limitation, not an automatic layout pass.
Multiple Jobs Worksheet title, instruction paragraphs, numbered questions, dollar lines and bottom rule are visible without malformed symbols.
Worksheet title, questions and amount lines match the original third page; the first-page annotation introduces no visible middle-page change.
Chinese W-4 heading and dense CJK instructions render with recognizable Chinese glyphs, intact checkboxes, amount grid and employer/signature rows.

Original Chinese form glyphs and table positions remain stable. The added CJK/ABC/123 test line crosses the lower-left employer table boundary because the probe supplies a fixed rectangle; no automatic collision avoidance is established.
Chinese Multiple Jobs Worksheet has intact bold heading, CJK paragraphs, numbered calculation prompts, amount lines and bottom rule.
Chinese worksheet line breaks, headings, dollar lines and lower whitespace match the source third page, with no annotation or visible alteration here.
Japanese PDL title, red introductory notice, black section headings, bullet marks and underlined example links render without visible missing-glyph boxes.
Japanese source layout and red notice are unchanged; the added Chinese/ABC/123 line is visible in the lower white margin without clipping.
Japanese sections 2 through 5, indented bullet paragraphs and underlined passages retain a consistent baseline and clear separation.
Japanese section headings, bullet indentation, underlines and paragraph wrapping match original page 2; the first-page annotation has no visible effect here.
PLOS logo, orange rule, article title, author block, left publication/license column, abstract and introduction are intact and visibly ordered.
The title/abstract/sidebar retain their original positions and colors; added Chinese/ABC/123 text sits in the lower white margin above the footer and is not clipped.
Large pale-blue striped coefficient table, black grid/labels, numerical columns, notes, lower body text and footer all render visibly.
Blue row fills, coefficient columns, note text and the lower body paragraph match source page 18; no visible color or geometry damage accompanies FreeText on page 1.
Dark-green textured scanned cover, upper-left barcode and NIST PUBLICATIONS labels remain visible with the original scan texture and shading.

The scanned cover texture and labels are preserved. The added black test annotation is faint against the dark-green lower cover; its low contrast is a known foreground/background limitation rather than evidence of missing CJK glyphs.
Yellowed typewritten scan shows page number 10, long scientific paragraphs and centered 5.2 Efficiency heading, including original uneven scan/print texture.
Typewritten lines, section heading, yellow paper shading and original right-edge scan boundary match source page 20 with no visible added crop or image distortion.

visualReview.acceptanceScope: Pass confirms this P0 sampled compatibility review: retained document painting, CJK appearance existence, and the deliberate blank first-page deletion agree with the independent structural/pixel audit. It does not accept automatic annotation placement, contrast choice, editable-form interaction or a production UX.

knownVisibleLimitations.finding: The fixed (20,20,300,45) probe annotation rectangle crosses existing employer-form content/borders. The original content is preserved but the added foreground can overprint it.
knownVisibleLimitations.followUpPhase: P4 annotation placement, preview and user-controlled layout; do not claim automatic collision avoidance.

knownVisibleLimitations.finding: Fixed black text has low contrast against the dark-green scanned cover. The AP is present and the scan is preserved, but readability is poor on this background.
knownVisibleLimitations.followUpPhase: P4 annotation foreground/background choices and preview; no automatic contrast selection is validated.

limitations: Only the 30 named Poppler samples were visually inspected. All 314 pages were not visually reviewed; GNU non-target 228-page preservation is an automated semantic check.
800-pixel page renders support layout and gross glyph checks, not high-resolution print quality or every small font contour.
Native PDFium renders were produced and hash-checked by the independent audit, but this report does not claim an individual visual comparison of all native PNGs.
XFA packet retention is structural evidence only; no XFA filling, script execution, dynamic reflow, real IME, physical keyboard, Linux/Kylin or official-reference performance is validated.
The intentionally generated PDFs are compatibility evidence, not polished end-user deliverables; known annotation placement and contrast findings are retained rather than concealed.
